facts.raw_span: A 23-year-old man presented with a 1-year history of a gradually enlarging mass on the anterior aspect of his right wrist, along the radial edge
Phalen’s maneuver and Durkan’s test were positive
indicating median nerve compression
Magnetic resonance imaging of the wrist demonstrated a well-defined, encapsulated mass on the radial side of the wrist
exhibited biphasic (central and peripheral) contrast enhancement (target sign)
